versions.subject: Merge PR #4997 from @MHaggis - Add rules related to PowerShell Web Access
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\dism.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'DISM.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'WindowsPowerShellWebAccess'
        - '/online'
        - '/enable-feature'
condition: all of selection_*
